speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have a concerning rash and recent health changes. To begin, can you describe exactly where the rash started and how it has spread since then?

speaker: Patient
text: 47-year-old male. The patient presents with a rash that started last night, finding it very concerning. He does not recall being exposed to any new environmental stimuli such as detergents or plants like poison ivy. He mentions he recently started seeing a primary care provider for arthritis management and a new onset cough.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is helpful information; can you describe the appearance of the rash and whether you are experiencing fever, joint pain, or shortness of breath? In the meantime, I will need to see the lesion, so please REQUEST IMAGES: Rash_photograph.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Rash on the upper half of the back. I also have Concern over sudden onset, Recent cough, Unaware of exposure to new environmental stimuli, Mucositis. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-induced DRESS Syndrome (Drug Reaction with Eosinophilia and Systemic Symptoms) likely triggered by new arthritis medication. REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC) with differential and Liver Function Tests (LFTs).
